title: BDR Support Apprentice
description:
About Us HighLevel is a cloud-based, all-in-one white-label marketing and sales platform that empowers marketing agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, from marketing agencies to entrepreneurs to small businesses and beyond. Our platform empowers users across industries to streamline operations, drive growth, and crush their goals. HighLevel processes over 15 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million domain names.

Our PeopleWith over 2000+ team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our ImpactEvery month, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About The Role:

Who You Are:You're excited about helping people and want to learn how a sales team works in a fun, fast-paced environment. You'll support our Business Development Representatives (BDRs) by answering replies from customers and prospects, booking and confirming meetings, sending reminders, following up with people who missed their call, and making sure warm leads get to the right BDR quickly.

You're comfortable working alongside a team that's busy and goal driven, and you're ready to learn new skills like managing your time, staying organized, and communicating clearly by phone, text, and email.

To do well in this role, you'll want to be confident, friendly, and positive, even when things get busy. You'll often be the first person a customer talks to after a BDR reaches out, so making a good impression matters. This apprenticeship is also a great way to learn how sales works and build toward a future BDR role at HighLevel . At HighLevel , everyone stays on camera during calls with customers, teammates, and managers.

Programme Details:

• Work Type: Apprenticeship

• Department: Revenue Growth

• Sub Department: Customer Retention

• Duration: 6 Months

• Shift timings: 08:00 AM - 05:00 PM CST (Mon-Fri)

• Monthly Stipend: 32,000

• Location: Remote (India)

• Programme Start: Nov 2026

What You'll Be Doing:

• Learning HighLevel 's products and the customers we serve, including agencies, small businesses, and SaaSpreneurs

• Answering replies to BDR outreach across calls, texts, chats, and emails

• Booking meetings and demos on BDR calendars and sending calendar invites

• Calling, texting, and emailing customers to confirm and remind them about upcoming meetings

• Following up with customers who missed a meeting and helping them reschedule

• Asking a few simple questions to understand what a customer needs before passing them to a BDR

• Passing warm and interested leads to the right BDR quickly so no opportunity is missed

• Welcoming customers into video meetings and making sure they're connected with their BDR

• Logging your conversations and next steps in our CRM so the team always knows where things stand

• Helping customers with basic questions or connecting them to the right team, like Support or Trial Experience

• Helping the team stay organized by setting reminders and keeping follow-ups on track

• Practical experience of German laboratory billing, invoicing and reimbursement processes.

• Demonstrable knowledge of KV and KBV billing requirements within the German healthcare environment.

• Experience configuring billing, invoicing, LIS, LIMS or comparable healthcare software.

• Understanding of laboratory processes and the relationship between test workflows, billing rules and invoice generation.

• Experience with requirements gathering, system testing, validation and customer implementation.

• Fluent German and professional proficiency in English.

Location: Germany

We navigate complex industry landscapes to drive transformative outcomes, helping businesses streamline operations, enhance customer experience, and achieve sustainable growth backed by a world-class Net Promoter Score of 75. Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) is integral to our mission. We believe that building inclusive, equitable teams is not only the right thing to do-it is also essential for driving innovation and better business outcomes. We actively promote equal opportunity through inclusive hiring practices, continuous learning programs, and regular equity assessments to ensure a fair and empowering workplace for all. Position Summary The Charge Entry Specialist is responsible for accurate and timely entry, verification, and processing of patient demographic, insurance, and charge billing data into practice management systems. This position plays a critical role in ensuring clean claim submission and smooth revenue cycle operations. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly accountable, and self-driven, capable of taking true ownership of work without requiring constant task assignment or monitoring. Preferred Qualifications ● Experience working in an outsourced RCM or multi-specialty billing setting. ● Familiarity with CPT, ICD-10, and modifier usage guidelines. Performance Expectations

title: Senior Mobile Product Engineer, Menu Discovery
description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month. Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

About the role: What's in the Box

HelloFresh’s Menu Discovery squad owns the customer experience that helps millions of people find and customise meals across brands and markets. The squad is compact and cross-functional, and what customers do in the app shapes every decision we make. The work runs on our React Native apps for iOS and Android, which turn federated GraphQL responses into fast, reliable shopping experiences. Performance is a requirement from day one, and we design for it from the first RFC. You’ll take features from RFC to production, rolling them out gradually across markets with feature flags and measuring impact through analytics events and A/B tests. Beyond the squad, you’ll help shape architecture across the tribe, from navigation and state management to module boundaries. If you want a large technical surface area and a visible impact on a large customer base, this role offers both.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

At HelloFresh we are moving away from a model where software developers just execute tickets toward one where product engineers are trusted to own customer problems. A Product Engineer takes a problem, forms a point of view, validates it with customers and data, and ships it using AI as a force multiplier.

• Lead the app experience, owning the metrics that reflect quality for mobile customers (retention, crash-free sessions, conversion).

• Work beyond your specialization when the problem demands it. Your specialization anchors your work without limiting it.

• Operate what you build. You instrument, monitor, and improve your systems in production. Shipping starts the learning cycle.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients 

• Hands-on experience working with AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) beyond casual experimentation. You use AI agents every day. You have a practical sense of how the context you provide to AI tools shapes output quality, and how to set boundaries on AI-generated work.

• Deep expertise in React Native and TypeScript. Proven ability to design, build, and operate high-traffic consumer mobile apps used by millions, with a clear understanding of the impact on software architecture, dependencies, and business value.

• Deep mobile engineering expertise, with experience across the app release cycle, test automation, on-device performance and platform UX conventions.

• You have product sense and are opinionated about what should be built and why, and you can back that opinion with data and user evidence.

title: Langfuse - Senior Product Engineer (US-East)
description:
WHY PRODUCT ENGINEERING AT LANGFUSE

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Everything you build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. Langfuse has 35,000+ GitHub stars and our SDKs are downloaded more than a hundred million times per month. When you ship a new feature the community notices in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community channels.

Product engineers at Langfuse are the people who deliver new features end-to-end to our users. You own the product thinking from understanding the user problem to deciding what to build to shipping the solution.

You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. The users you serve are some of the best and most ambitious software engineers leveraging Langfuse to improve their applications. Deeply understanding the problems they solve will help you design the best possible product and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

 

YOU WILL GROW AT LANGFUSE BY

- Own features end-to-end: from talking to users, to writing the spec, to shipping the code and docs, to writing the changelog post https://langfuse.com/changelog with your name on it. To give you a sense: recent features a single engineer owned include the Langfuse for Agents https://langfuse.com/changelog/2025-11-05-langfuse-for-agents release (new trace views, agent graphs, semantic span labels), the TypeScript SDK v4 https://langfuse.com/changelog/2025-08-28-typescript-sdk-v4-ga rewrite on OpenTelemetry, and managing dashboards via API/CLI/MCP https://langfuse.com/changelog/2026-07-17-dashboard-and-widget-operations-in-api.

- Work across the full stack: and we mean full. Our surface area is wide: React frontend, Next.js backend, ClickHouse analytics, Python and TypeScript SDKs, public docs, Terraform modules, and more. You'll touch whatever the feature needs. One week you might be writing a new ClickHouse query for cost analytics, the next you're designing an SDK API, the next you're building a new rust worker for faster data processing.

- Talk to users constantly: jump on calls, respond in community channels, and route support requests. At Langfuse, support is how we build conviction about what to build next. Our handbook says it best: support by engineers is a core value proposition.

- Write public documentation about the features you own. At Langfuse, docs are product.

- Ship publicly during Launch Weeks: we've run four Launch Weeks https://langfuse.com/blog/2025-10-29-launch-week-4 so far, dropping a new feature every day for a week. Engineers present the features they built to the community.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Someone who has built features or even entire products from scratch end-to-end

- Experience building and shipping user-facing products end-to-end, ideally in TypeScript/React and with exposure to data-intensive backends

- Someone who can manage projects themselves. You know how to develop strong conviction about what to build and how to ship it.

- Taste for great developer experience: you care about API design, UI details, and clear documentation

- Interest in open source software and genuine excitement about talking to developers about their problems

- Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

- CS or quantitative degree preferred

Bonus points:

- Experience with ClickHouse, analytics databases, or building complex data visualizations

- Former founder or early startup experience

- Contributions to popular open source projects

- ML/AI background or familiarity with the LLM framework ecosystem

No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply.

 

PERKS

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need-and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework - be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

• Explorer (Level 1) - Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

• Builder (Level 2) - Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

• Integrator (Level 3) - Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role
Kaia Health, part of Sword Health , is the digital therapy for musculoskeletal (MSK) pain in Germany. Doctors can prescribe it and statutory health insurers cover it.
As Performance Marketing Manager you drive patient growth for Kaia in Germany through paid acquisition. You own our paid channels, with Meta first and Google next, and you are accountable for one thing above all: bringing in more qualified leads at a lower cost. You don't stop at the ad. You optimise the whole path from first click to sign-up, including landing pages, messaging and conversion rates.
You'll be a key member of our German growth team, working closely with Sword's international Growth and Marketing teams and our agency partners. This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership.
What you’ll be doing

• Paid media management: Plan, run and optimise campaigns on Meta, then expand to Google Search and other channels as we grow our mix

• Lead cost optimisation: Own cost per lead and cost per qualified lead, and continuously improve both through targeting, bidding, creative and funnel changes

• Experimentation: Run structured tests on creative, audiences, messaging and landing pages, then scale what works

• Budget & reporting: Manage budgets and pacing, and build your own reporting on CPL, CAC, CVR and ROAS, from click to activated patient together with Operations

• Agency management: Steer external agencies and freelancers and hold them accountable for results

What you need to have

• Native-level German (C2)

About the Company

Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

 

Role Summary

The Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the implementation, compliance, and continuous improvement of environmental, health, and safety programs within the organization. This role requires a proactive approach to identify potential hazards, ensure regulatory compliance, and promote a culture of safety among employees.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Program Development and Management:

• Develop, implement, and maintain EHS policies, procedures, and programs in accordance with local, state, and federal regulations.

• Ensure effective communication of EHS policies to all employees.

• Regulatory Compliance:

• Monitor and ensure compliance with environmental and safety regulations, standards, and best practices.

• Conduct regular audits and inspections to identify compliance gaps and ensure corrective actions are taken.

• Training and Awareness:

• Design and deliver EHS training programs for employees at all levels, ensuring understanding and compliance with safety protocols.

• Promote a culture of safety through awareness campaigns and engagement initiatives.

• Incident Management:

• Investigate workplace accidents, incidents, and near misses; prepare reports and recommend corrective actions.

• Maintain records of incidents and ensure proper documentation and reporting to regulatory bodies.

• Risk Assessment:

• Conduct risk assessments and safety inspections to identify potential hazards and recommend mitigation strategies.

• Work with management to prioritize safety improvements and allocate resources effectively.

• Emergency Preparedness:

• Develop and implement emergency response plans and drills to prepare employees for potential emergency situations.

• Coordinate with local emergency services and ensure compliance with emergency response regulations.

• Data Analysis and Reporting:

• Analyze safety data and trends to provide insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.

• Prepare and present EHS reports to management, highlighting key metrics and areas for improvement.

• Collaboration and Communication:

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to promote a safe and healthy work environment.

- Create custom proposals and business cases aligned with commercial goals and customer budgeting cycles, leading commercial conversations to ensure terms reflect the value Pleo delivers.

- A solid understanding of value-based selling and consultative approach

- Skilled in contract negotiations and building business cases linking features to value

- Strong understanding of qualification methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC)

- A passion for solving problems with a solution-oriented approach

- Data-driven, goal-oriented, and accurate forecasting ability

- Strong commercial acumen and ability to navigate senior stakeholders

- A background in SaaS Account Managemen

title: Product & Regulatory Counsel
description:
TIRED OF MEETING THE PRODUCT AT THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS STAGE?

Most product lawyers see the flow once it's built and the launch date is set. Here, you're on the whiteboard at ideation, so compliant by design is the plan, not the clean-up.

And the stakes are real. Taptap Send moves billions of dollars every month across 100 countries, and is now building wallets, cards and broader financial products for diaspora communities.

THE JOB

You'll advise on new licensing and products from first idea to go-live, and own regulator engagement across our markets.

- Shape products before they're built: review designs, UX, flows and terms against regulatory and customer-outcome rules, Consumer Duty included, while change is still cheap.

- Turn regulation into decisions: what's mandatory, what's prudent, and the alternative route that still gets it launched.

- Own the regulator relationship: across our markets, including new ones, and flag what regulatory change means for the roadmap early.

- Take products to new countries: localise what already works, with country leads and local counsel.

- Build the playbooks: templates that let Legal scale without adding friction.

WHY YOU'LL WANT IT

Spend your time on the hard questions. You're asked to shape our roadmap and launches, and understand how to fit them to the relevant regimes

Be a peer, with room to run. You'll join a flat team of regulatory and commercial lawyers, with real autonomy and a manager who trusts you.

Make launches faster, not slower. Legal in the room from day one is how products here ship sooner. That's the whole point of your seat.

Make sending money home cheaper. Remittances pay for school fees, rent and medical bills, and are worth more than all foreign aid combined. Cheaper, reliable transfers put more of that money in families' hands.

IS THIS YOU?

You're a qualified lawyer (UK or equivalent) with 4+ years' PQE in payments, e-money or financial services regulation, at a firm, a regulator or a fintech.

You've advised payments or e-money firms under the FCA or an equivalent regime, dealt with the regulator directly, and helped product teams take live launches over the line.

You give the answer first and the reasoning second. Ambiguity across several jurisdictions doesn't stop you making the call.

If you'd rather be asked first than asked last, apply. Missing a box or two? Send your CV anyway.

title: Security & IT Operations Engineer
description:
About Prefect

Prefect builds automation for an unpredictable world. The last decade of automation was about protecting workflows from unpredictability; in the agentic era, unpredictability is the point. Our mission is to give people confidence in automated work, whether that work is a mission-critical data pipeline or a fleet of AI agents.

In August 2026, Prefect and Dagster, competitors for eight years, joined forces to build the next generation of automation infrastructure. Today, our ecosystem includes Dagster, the data platform; Prefect, the agent platform; and FastMCP, the leading open-source developer framework for the MCP ecosystem. Together, our open-source and commercial products are trusted by Fortune 500 companies, data innovators, and high-growth technology companies around the world.

We think of our culture as the operating system of the company. We’ve carefully created a supportive, high-performance environment that empowers our team to do the best work of their careers, have meaningful impact, and continue growing personally and professionally. We’re a remote-first team that values high standards, ownership, and thoughtful collaboration.

THE ROLE

In August, Dagster and Prefect became one company. Behind the scenes, that left us with two of nearly everything: two SOC 2 programs, two ways of managing laptops, overlapping tools and accounts, and a long list of tools that each need one clear owner. We're hiring a Security & IT Operations Engineer to turn all of it into one setup that runs well and gets easier to run every quarter.

You'll own the day-to-day of our security compliance program and our corporate IT. You'll report to our Security & Systems Lead as the first hire on this new team.

Our customers are enterprise data, infrastructure, ML and AI teams, and our products run code inside their data infrastructure. AI has made attacks cheap and fast, so customers look hard at how we protect them, and a well-run security and compliance program is a big part of our answer. You won’t be pushing security uphill here. More engineers volunteered for our new Security Guild than its first sprint had room for. Building on both companies’ existing security work, the guild is implementing shared product security tools and consistent vulnerability management and incident response processes across Prefect and Dagster. That commitment is helping us stay ahead of AI-accelerated attacks.

You’ll enjoy this role if you like a mix of hands-on work and longer-term improvements, and want a meaningful say in how our IT and compliance programs run.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

- Run day-to-day compliance. Keep SOC 2 controls, evidence collection, access reviews, policy acknowledgments and training on track. Work directly with auditors and control owners, and follow findings through to resolution.

- Help consolidate our compliance programs. With our team lead and consultant, choose a GRC platform and set up both programs. Help adapt control descriptions across environments and design activities that minimize manual work.

- Own corporate IT. Run Google Workspace and our SaaS apps, handle onboarding and offboarding with People Operations, and manage our Mac fleet in Rippling. Help employees with laptop and access issues, and improve the setup as you learn where people get stuck.

- Improve access management. Work with our identity partner on how access is requested, approved, granted and removed. Own the daily processes and keep them documented.

- Protect corporate systems. Manage macOS and application updates, investigate endpoint alerts, and track vulnerabilities through remediation. Verify fixes and participate in phishing and other corporate incident response with our team lead.

- Automate repetitive work. Use scripts, APIs, workflow tools or AI to reduce manual IT and compliance tasks and make common requests self-service.

title: Co-Founder & CEO — Supply Chain Tech | AI Returns Recovery
description:
The Opportunity
FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadRiuso, an AI recommerce venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.
Riusois the operating record for electronics returns and liquidation benches. Owner-operated resellers and refurbishers spend around eleven minutes identifying, grading and pricing each returned or liquidated unit by hand. When the bench backs up, units default to the liquidation pallet, the lowest-value exit.Riusoidentifies and grades each unit from photos in seconds and prices every disposition route, from resell and refurb to part-out, wholesale and pallet. It then routes the unit to the highest-recovery option. Every decision becomes memory the bench owns: repeat models price instantly, seller manifest accuracy builds over time, and outbound IMEI records turn mismatched returns into winnable claims. It runs on a phone and a label printer, with no integration.
Market Context
US consumers returned an estimated $849.9B of merchandise in 2025, and North American refurbished electronics is a roughly $17B market growing at double digits. Riuso addresses a $2.2B TAM across North American returns and recommerce benches. Its beachhead is 12,000 electronics-focused owner-operators, a $144M SAM. Right-to-repair laws now in force across California, New York, Texas, Oregon and five other states are deepening the parts market. Tariffs on new devices are pulling more buyers toward refurbished. Both make every unit on the bench worth more to price correctly.
About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.
You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Keebo automatically optimizes cloud data warehouses for Snowflake and Databricks to control compute costs without hurting query performance. Our platform learns each customer's workloads and adjusts warehouse settings in real time, so data teams don't have to. We're venture-backed, built on years of database and machine learning research, and fully remote.

About the Opportunity
We're an AI-first engineering team. We use agents across design, implementation, review, and testing, and we hold their output to the same standard as any other pull request: read it, question it, and reject it when it’s wrong. We adopt new tools and processes quickly, and we drop what isn’t working.
As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll design and scale the systems behind our platform. You'll use AI to multiply your own output and the team's, and work directly with the product to turn customer problems into shipped features.
You Will

• Design reliable systems that process large volumes of customer warehouse data

• Evaluate new tools and models, and share the worthy ones with the team

• Write architecture docs that explain what we're building, the tradeoffs, and why

• Mentor engineers, including working effectively with AI coding tools

You Have

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time at an early-stage startup (Seed through Series B)

• A track record of scaling systems as load, data, and customers grow

• Strong architectural skills, with examples

• Proficiency in Java, Python, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript, plus strong SQL

• Experience with cloud platforms, containers, and automated deploy pipelines

• Clear, collaborative communication, especially in writing: you explain what matters and why

• Experience with data cloud platforms. Especially Snowflake or Databricks

• Experience with Angular

• Experience building AI agents, agent tooling, or Model Context Protocol servers

• Knowledge of query optimization, machine learning, or algorithm development

Working with a world-class team of researchers and engineers in machine learning to turn Al algorithms into scalable and automated cloud products

• Home office stipend

• The latest AI tools, and freedom to try new ones

As a diverse mix of individuals, we make one big unstoppable team.

The opportunity.

Our Quantexa Delivery team is all about bringing context to data. Lead Data Engineers are drivers within our fast-paced delivery teams, implementing Quantexa’s innovative technology for an ever-expanding list of domains including banking, insurance, government, healthcare. We are problem solvers, delivering sophisticated end-to-end big data solutions to our internal and external client stakeholders. As a central part of our team, you will experience opportunities beyond that of an engineer. You enjoy leading by example, guiding and mentoring data engineers to solve complex technical problems, sharing success with the team and taking pride in achieving milestones together. You share success with the team and take pride in the sum of its achievements. You will balance your time engaging with our business teams and clients to break down requirements into technical tasks, working hands-on as a programmer, and supporting the work of other engineers within a collaborative environment.

The work you do here will be impactful. The challenges we tackle are big, but they're also incredibly rewarding. Your leadership in managing, transforming, and cleansing high volume data help our clients solve business problems across a wide range of areas including fraud, financial crime, data management, risk and customer intelligence.

What you’ll be doing.

- You will lead, support, and mentor a team of junior data engineers within an agile framework.

- Write defensive, fault tolerant and efficient code for production level data processing systems.

- You’ll configure and deploy Quantexa’s software using tools such as Spark, Hadoop, Scala, Elasticsearch, with our platform being hosted on both private and public virtual clouds, such as Google cloud, Microsoft Azure and Amazon.

- You will be a trusted source of knowledge to your clients. You will articulate technical concepts to a non-technical audience helping them to make big decisions.

title: [CONTRACT] Part-Time Sales Compensation Analyst

From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

- Respond to rep inquiries with clarity and professionalism

- High attention to detail and comfort working with plan rules, rates, and payout logic

- Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets

- Ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines independently in a fully remote environment

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience drafting or editing participation agreements or comp plan documents

- Familiarity with CRM data (Salesforce) and how it feeds comp calculations

title: Staff Decision Scientist, Sales
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Most delivery companies sell on price and volume, and find out later whether a client made them money. Sales teams are measured on what they sign, not on what a signing is worth. Relay wants every client, and every new shop in the network, to be one we'd choose again.

That is harder for us than for most, because what a client is worth depends on how their parcels flow through a network that's still growing. Engineering and analytics engineering build what you design.

SALES HIGHLIGHTS

- You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what a client or shop is worth and which signings sales should chase. The sales lead acts on your calls.

- What is a new client or a new shop worth, when its value depends on where it sits in a network that changes every month? What would you build so sales knows before it signs?

- Which signings become partners who do well with us, and what does that tell sales to look for?

- The quarter's target is set. What has to close by when for it to hold, and what would tell you early that it won't?

- A whole area, not a slice: you decide how sales values what it wins, and the result shows in what we sign next.

- Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Staff Decision Scientist, Sales at Relay, you'll:

- Decide which Sales problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

- Design how Sales decides: which signals count, what a client or shop is worth, and what good looks like.

- Tell the sales lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

- Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

- Go and look when the numbers and the street disagree: a new shop, a client's parcels at the sort centre.

- Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, sales chooses what to go after on measures you built, and can see whether the quarter will land before it ends.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Have owned B2B pricing or commercial decisions and their number, rather than maintaining sales dashboards.

- Have built, hands on, the first version of how a company values a customer or a deal: unit economics, lifetime value, or what it costs to win one.

- Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or sales went after different deals because of it.

- Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

- Can say early whether a qua

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

description:

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

THE ROLE

Strategic Initiatives is a small team of generalists within Operations. We take on a few important, urgent problems at a time: ones that cross teams and don’t have a natural owner. We help solve them, then move on. Either the work is done, or we hand what needs to keep running to a long-term owner.

The work takes three forms:

- Solve business problems. Get to the bottom of an important question, help leaders decide what comes next and put the decision into practice.

And we’re setting up how Legora runs its top company priorities, including the weekly forum where their owners and leadership review progress and make decisions.

You’ll join as a senior individual contributor reporting to the Head of Strategic Initiatives. You’ll lead projects across Legora, each backed by an executive sponsor. Work comes from a leader, or from a problem we spot ourselves, and your first assignment will depend on where the company needs you most.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Scope the work with the teams involved: define the problem, what success looks like and what we won’t do, and agree it with the executive sponsor before we start.

- Talk to the people closest to the work, analyse the data and weigh the options. Recommend a way forward and explain the trade-offs.

- Build and test the solution with the teams that will use it. Step into the work yourself when that’s what it takes to get it running.

- Agree who owns each part of the work and manage dependencies across teams. Bring decisions to the executive sponsor early enough to keep the work moving.

- Measure what changed and adjust where needed. Close out the work once you’ve delivered the agreed outcome, or hand it over once a long-term owner is ready to run it.

- You’ve led complex projects across different parts of a business and earned the trust of the teams doing the work.

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

About the Team

We build the AI agent that helps merchandisers, product managers, and executives grow their e-commerce business: it finds opportunities in their data, tailors insights to each person's role, and takes routine work off their plate by delivering answers where they already work. We are transforming how digital merchandising teams work: instead of digging through reports and configuring rules by hand, they ask in plain language, get answers grounded in their own data, and approve the changes the agent prepares. Customers already rely on the agent to save time and make better decisions.

We own the agent end to end, from the first question a merchant asks to the answer they act on. We also own the analytics behind it: the pipelines and cubes for search, browse, and recommendation performance, and the metric definitions merchants rely on.

That is why we build the agent and the Customer Dashboard as a platform that every Constructor team extends. We create the foundation that other teams build on: the agent framework, shared components, and infrastructure. On top of it, teams add their own data, tools, and skills, so the agent can answer questions in their domain and the dashboard can show their features without separate interfaces. Each new capability gives merchants more ways to grow their business.

- Experience with data quality and pipeline monitoring: freshness checks, alerting, incident response

- Ability to prototype fast and pick the metrics that matter in e-commerce

- Ability to translate business questions into technical requirements, and back

- Clear communication with engineers and non-technical stakeholders

Nice-to-have

- Experience building frontend UIs, or willingness to work across the full stack to ship data into product features

- Experience with pandas, NumPy

- Experience building AI agents: tools, skills, prompts, context, and evaluations

- Experience with real-time analytics: ClickHouse, Cube.js

- Experience with AWS

- Familiarity with statistics for experimentation (A/B tests)
